review: OK service but they don't seem to close previous deliveries so you are unable order another delivery. Their "contact" page is a joke, type your issue yet it dosent allow you to add text to the box your supposed to use.

This app is garbage, if you want to contact McDonald's through this app it won't work. The animations are intermittent and the ordering process or point usage options are a pain to use. You get better service by going in store and thats if your lucky because the staff is just as useless as contacting the company
